entities.name: Lakil
entities.description: Shepherdess from Lambholt on Innistrad, killed by Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: Nightmarish creature summoned by Arinos and Ariosa.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Archmage who investigated the supernatural events.

entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: Arinos's daughter who helped summon Old Stickfingers.

events.summary: Lakil is found dead in the pasture, mutilated, her sheep untouched.
events.quote: She was found dead in the pasture

events.summary: Her death prompts the villagers to seek Vadrik and Rem Karolus.
events.quote: leading them to seek help from Vadrik and Rem

events.summary: Her death is revealed to be linked to Old Stickfingers, summoned by Arinos and Ariosa.
events.quote: a mythical and nightmarish creature summoned by the villager Arinos and his daughter Ariosa

relations.quote: She was one of the victims of Old Stickfingers .
